checks.evidence: Dimensioned apartment subassemblies, fasteners, sash/rail/AC detail tooling exists; generated window optics separates two sliding glass leaves from the frame and interior backing instead of relying on one opaque window block. Occupant-controlled curtain dressing is a separate physical layer behind the repeated manufactured sash, with 30 deterministic assemblies, physical LOD0 pleats and LOD0/1/2/3 staging.
Generated detail geometry has a non-razor-edge replacement pass.
Danchi master geometry has explicit LOD staging; the apartment curtain layer independently uses four cross-faded LOD levels so close pleats are not paid at distance.

Root/trunk/branch/twig/leaf hierarchy tooling exists; tree anchors also receive root-zone planting interfaces rather than remaining visually disconnected from the plaza/grass substrate. Static clone-risk QA normalizes tree roots and rejects exact render-hierarchy duplicates among simultaneously active generated fallbacks.

Two-sided foliage optics and transmission shader are present, with measured-order dielectric F0/GGX constraints and explicit QA. Cause-based understory uses the same thin-leaf optical model and four renderer-distinct cross-faded LOD levels with density reduced toward pedestrian-pressure sources.

Weathering remains driven by rain/splash/drain/contact/UV context rather than arbitrary grime. The facade pass reconstructs grade splash, sill/downpipe runoff, balcony drip residue, sparse rail-fixing rust and AC drain residue as non-colliding source-anchored meshes; vegetation density likewise follows ordinary maintenance/foot-traffic pressure rather than random decoration.

PBR generation includes physical-scale infrastructure micro maps, metre-derived macro/detail base-ground layers, a two-scale non-metallic facade coating, physically separated dielectric glazing, dry non-metallic weathering residue materials, root-zone soil/precast tree-pit materials, transmitted-light foliage, park/street-furniture PBR sets, and curtain-fabric families with textile normal/albedo structure. Active map registration/sampling and actual scene material metallic/specular ranges have dedicated QA.

One deterministic midsummer solar model drives SummerSun, procedural sky sun reference, sky-derived ambient fill and default specular environment. Two 512px HDR local reflection probes use ViaScripting/NoTimeSlicing and BlendProbesAndSkybox. Pre-capture refresh now retains RenderIDs, requires IsFinishedRendering(RenderID)=true, verifies created Cube realtimeTexture dimensions, writes a Unity runtime receipt, and aborts the benchmark capture if synchronization is unproven.

Generated fallbacks remain replaceable by authored FBX/GLB art; facade optics and occupancy variation skip when the danchi authored-art slot is active. Vegetation ecology keys from stable tree-slot anchors, so authored tree replacement does not require moving the surrounding root-zone interface.

Per-component manufacture/material/angular-light-response registry exists, with foundation/grade, facade/glazing, apartment window dressing, environment, reflection synchronization, facade-weathering, vegetation-ecology, scene-repetition and park/street-furniture contracts. Metadata records manufacture, dimensions, mounting, clearances, albedo/roughness/metallic/F0/normal/microstructure/wetness/UV aging/angular response, geometry-vs-material split and LOD policy where applicable.

Dedicated 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture code with pixel-exact 100% crops rebuilds and saves the detailed benchmark before capture. The realtime reflection refresh called immediately before Camera.Render now fails closed unless both benchmark probe RenderIDs are finished and their 512px Cube textures are created; the complete review packet validates the machine-readable sync contract before capture and validates the Unity runtime receipt after sealed still evidence is produced.

Capture contract records exact hero/oblique/grazing view/crop paths plus intended sky/reflection state and explicitly remains unrendered until Unity executes it. Reflection synchronization has an additional runtime receipt rather than relying only on the manifest's Boolean intent flag. No static check is allowed to clear a critical visual defect.
No actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner compile verification artifact exists yet.

latestRun.verification: GitHub source/static inspection plus current Unity 6 API documentation review only. The existing 4K path called RenderProbe() immediately before hero/oblique/grazing capture but discarded the returned RenderID while the manifest later asserted probesRefreshedImmediatelyBeforeCapture=true. This pass changes the refresh to fail closed: each of the two registered 512px HDR probes is forced to NoTimeSlicing, its RenderID is retained, IsFinishedRendering(RenderID) must be true, and realtimeTexture must be a created 512x512 Cube. A runtime receipt records Unity version, graphics device, IDs and texture state. The Native 4K Review Packet validates the synchronization contract before capture and the generated receipt after still evidence. Unity 6 documentation states RenderProbe returns a RenderID, IsFinishedRendering checks completion for that RenderID, and NoTimeSlicing renders the probe entirely in one frame. No Unity runner exists on this branch: workflow runs and commit-status contexts remain absent, and no Assets/QA/Captures4K directory is present. Therefore this is source-side evidence-integrity hardening only; no render-quality claim or Visual Fidelity points are awarded.
expectedVisualScoreImpact: Lighting/shadows/reflections: prevents stale local cubemaps from being accepted as current lighting evidence after sky/sun/scene rebuilds.

Material/PBR physical plausibility: makes grazing-angle review of glazing, aluminum, galvanized/painted metal and wetness-sensitive surfaces correspond to the same current environment used by the captured frame.

Cinematic image quality: reduces the chance that exposure/highlight judgments are contaminated by stale specular energy while preserving the rule that objective synchronization cannot award image-quality points.

Critical defect integrity: the pipeline can no longer equate merely issuing RenderProbe() with proven completion; if current reflections are unproven, native-4K capture aborts rather than producing scoreable evidence.
latestRun.nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner compile and native 3840x2160 capture evidence. On first runner, execute the complete Native 4K Review Packet. If probe completion fails, fix the runtime synchronization path before any visual review. If it succeeds, stop speculative expansion and inspect hero/oblique/grazing plus 100% crops for probe seams, glass Fresnel balance, metallic highlight plausibility, light leaks, clipping, aliasing and the highest actual deduction before adding new content.
